864-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-4186-8181.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

215-647-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-647-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

512-950-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-950-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-5223-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

728-3249-4289-5173.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-5173.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5256-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5256-6351.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

254-5256--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2

1558-2097-3875-4231-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2781-3817-5686.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

225-539-6071-6845.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three permanent cards in your graveyard.
225-539-6071-6845.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Byte enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Byte trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
225-539-6071-6845.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

876-3168-7070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
Urza's Incubator is naming one of the additional nontoken creature's types.
876-3168-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat.

3293-4693-4826-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-4693-4826-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-4693-4826-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2173-5220-5686-6535.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1074-3525-6006.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

2257-4452-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-4452-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Rukarumel, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-4694-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-4694-6788.description:
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-4694-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

325-1786-3017-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1786-3017-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3967-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
3967-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3967-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3398-6113.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has power 7 or greater, does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-3398-6113.description:
Declare Crystalline Crawler and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Crystalline Crawler.
Quilled Greatwurm triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Crystalline Crawler and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1467-3634-4377-4568.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-3634-4377-4568.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Walk the Aeons to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

575-3510-4214.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
575-3510-4214.description:
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Repeat.

1017-1089-1495.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter.
Wizard Class is level three.
1017-1089-1495.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

1116-3240-4247-4289.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Graveborn token.
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
